# FolkUp

> Independent open-content publisher producing free encyclopedias, books, and a public manifesto. Long-form writing — one person plus a team of AI fornits. Every publication signed by Andrei Klemenchonok.

## About

FolkUp is a single-person editorial enterprise — Andrei Klemenchonok with a team of AI fornits — publishing free encyclopedias, books, and the Unenclosed Knowledge Declaration. Banking-level fact verification, OSINT-anchored sources, transparent editorial process. Content is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; code is MIT/Apache 2.0. Funded by commissioned work, not advertising.

## Encyclopedias

- [Setubal](https://setubal.folkup.city/): City encyclopedia — Setubal, Portugal. History, neighborhoods, culture, food, walks.
- [Padel](https://padel.folkup.fit/): Padel sport encyclopedia — rules (FIP 2026), technique, tactics, equipment, history.
- [Mushrooms of Portugal](https://cogumelos.folkup.fit/): Edible and toxic mushrooms of Portugal — identification, ecology, foraging ethics.
- [Tarot Hub](https://tarot.folkup.life/): Tarot encyclopedia (Rider-Waite system) — symbolism, deck structure, spreads, personal practice.
- [Aquarium](https://aquarium.folkup.city/): Freshwater aquarium encyclopedia — fish, plants, water chemistry, equipment.
- [Lucerna](https://lucerna.folkup.app/): Underwater photography reference — gear, light, marine life, dive sites.
- [Retro-Tech (Runet 90s-2000s)](https://dialup.folkup.city/): Russian internet encyclopedia of the dial-up era — software, hardware, culture, sites.

## Books

- [Agile Sapiens](https://sapiens.folkup.life/): Book on humanity, agility, and complex systems. Long-form essays in EN/RU/PT.
- [FolkUp Quest](https://quest.folkup.app/): Interactive story-driven learning game project.

## Research

- [Underground Academia](https://underground.folkup.life/): Cultural seismography research platform. Long-form pieces tracking pre-surface cultural shifts.
- [The Unenclosed Knowledge Declaration](https://declaration.folkup.app/): Public manifesto — seven principles against the enclosure of the mind. Initiated by FolkUp, open for signature. Mirror at https://folkup.app/declaration/.
